### Creating our first plot

```{python}
import altair as alt

alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle()
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x='gdpPercap',
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x='gdpPercap',
    y='lifeExp',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y='lifeExp',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle(size=60, color='red', opacity=0.3).encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
    color='continent',
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
    color=alt.Color('continent').scale(scheme='set1'),
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
    color=alt.Color('continent').scale(scheme='set1'),
    size=alt.Size('pop').title('Population'),
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
    color=alt.Color('continent').scale(scheme='set1'),
    size=alt.Size('pop').title('Population (in millions)'),
).transform_calculate(
    pop='datum.pop/1000000'
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
    color=alt.Color('continent').scale(scheme='set1'),
    size=alt.Size('pop').title('Population (in millions)'),
    shape='continent',
    tooltip=['country', 
             alt.Tooltip('pop')
             .title('Population in million')
             .format(',.1f')
             ],
).transform_calculate(
    pop='datum.pop/1000000'
).properties(
    title='Do people in wealthy countries live longer?',
).interactive()
```


### Discrete Plots


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x='lifeExp',
    y='continent',
    color='continent',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').scale(zero=False),
    y='continent',
    color=alt.Color('continent').legend(None),
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_tick().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').scale(zero=False),
    y='continent',
    color=alt.Color('continent').legend(None),
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_boxplot().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').scale(zero=False),
    y='continent',
    color=alt.Color('continent').legend(None),
)
```

### Univariate Plots

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').bin(),
    y='count()',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').bin(step=2).title('Life expectancy'),
    y='count()',
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X('lifeExp').bin(step=2).title('Life expectancy'),
    y='count()',
    color='continent',
).properties(
    height=300,
    width=600,
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_line().encode(
    x='lifeExp',
    y='density:Q',
).transform_density(
    'lifeExp',
    as_=['lifeExp', 'density'],
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_area(opacity=0.5).encode(
    x='lifeExp',
    y='density:Q',
).transform_density(
    'lifeExp',
    as_=['lifeExp', 'density'],
)
```

### Plotting for data exploration

```{python}
gapminder = pd.read_csv("./data/gapminder_data.csv")

gapminder
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_circle().encode(
    x='year',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_circle().encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_line().encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_line().encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
    detail='country',
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_line().encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
    detail='country',
).transform_filter(
    alt.datum.continent == 'Asia'
)
```


```{python}
alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_line().encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
).transform_filter(
    alt.datum.country == 'United States'
)
```




### Layered charts

```{python}
base = alt.Chart(gapminder).encode(
    x='year:O',
    y='lifeExp',
).transform_filter(
    alt.datum.country == 'United States'
)

base.mark_line() + base.mark_point()
```

```{python}
base = alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').title('GDP Per Capita').scale(type='log'),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').title('Life Expectancy'),
)

points = base.mark_circle().encode(
    tooltip='country'
)

points
```

```{python}
reg_line = base.mark_line(color='red').transform_regression(
    on='gdpPercap', regression='lifeExp', method='log',
)
reg_line
```

```{python}
points + reg_line
```

### Interactive charts

```{python}
base = alt.Chart(gapminder_1997).mark_circle().encode(
    x='gdpPercap',
    y='lifeExp',
    color='continent',
)

selection = alt.selection_point(fields=['continent'], bind='legend')

base.encode(
    opacity=alt.when(selection).then(alt.value(0.9)).otherwise(alt.value(0.2)),
).add_params(
    selection
)

```

```{python}
chart = alt.Chart(gapminder).mark_circle().encode(
    x=alt.X('gdpPercap').scale(type='log', domain=[100, 1e5]),
    y=alt.Y('lifeExp').scale(domain=[20, 90]),
    size=alt.Size('pop').legend(None),
    tooltip='country',
)

slider = alt.binding_range(
    min=1952,
    max=2007,
    step=5,
    name='Year: '
)

year_selection = alt.selection_point(
    fields=['year'],
    bind=slider,
    value={'year': 1952}
)

chart.add_params(
    year_selection
).transform_filter(
    year_selection
)
```
